in_marathi.name: Ayushmaan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Life, Health, Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayushmaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ayushmaan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ayush' which means 'life' or 'health'. The suffix 'maan' means 'prosperous' or 'healthy'. Thus, Ayushmaan can be interpreted as 'one who is full of life' or 'one who is prosperous'. This name is popular in Hindu culture and is often given to newborn boys.

vedic_reference.note: Ayushman is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'ayush' which means 'long-lived'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Dhanvantari, the god of Ayurveda, is also known as Ayushman. This name is considered auspicious and is given to babies who are believed to be blessed with a long and prosperous life.
